title: Growth beyond exponent $3/2$ for convexity and iterated sum sets
summary: We prove that the bound \[ \max \{ |16A|,|16f(A)| \} \gg_m |A|^{\frac{3}{2}+\frac{1}{162}} \] holds for any polynomial $f$ with degree $m \geq 2$ and any finite $A \subset \mathbb R$. This shows that the classical Jarník obstruction to growth beyond exponent $3/2$, which occurs for general strictly convex functions, cannot occur for polynomial functions.
